summary: Preinstall OAST beacon to attacker-controlled interactsh collector
details: aia-b-locator-fe@1.0.3 declares a `preinstall` lifecycle script that executes `node index.js`, which performs a DNS lookup against a unique subdomain of `oast.fun` (ProjectDiscovery interactsh), specifically `ojoecyzdevxakimabqtr9bimrjqhw66zr.oast.fun`. The package ships no library functionality, has empty author/description metadata, and the only install-time effect is the out-of-band DNS beacon. On `npm install`, the installer's resolver IP and hostname are leaked to the operator of the OAST collector, confirming successful installation inside the target environment. The name and shape are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe staged for a follow-on attack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
